# CuriosityFields

> A knowledge-first digital publication exploring science, technology, artificial intelligence, history, astronomy, and future innovation.

CuriosityFields publishes long-form, editorially reviewed articles authored by the CuriosityFields Editorial Desk. Content is organized into six primary categories and updated regularly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.curiosityfields.com/): Featured stories and latest articles across all categories.
- [Categories](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories): Browse all topic hubs.
- [About](https://www.curiosityfields.com/about): Editorial mission, standards, and team.
- [Contact](https://www.curiosityfields.com/contact): Reach the editorial team.
- [Write For Us](https://www.curiosityfields.com/write-for-us): Contributor guidelines and accepted topics.

## Categories

- [Science](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/science): Discoveries, biology, physics, and research.
- [Technology](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/technology): Computing, infrastructure, and digital culture.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/artificial-intelligence): AI research, models, and societal impact.
- [History](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/history): Civilisations, archaeology, and historical inflection points.
- [Astronomy](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/astronomy): Cosmology, space exploration, and the universe.
- [Future Innovation](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/future-innovation): Emerging tech and forward-looking science.

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://www.curiosityfields.com/terms): Site terms and content usage policy.
